UserProgress.title: User Progressive Game State
UserProgress.description: Stores user's unlocked levels, best level times, and client settings.

userId.description: Unique identifier for the user matching their Firebase Auth UID.

unlockedLevels.description: List of level numbers that the user has unlocked.

levelBestTimes.description: Key-value pair of level numbers/IDs to best completion time in seconds.

settings.description: User specific configuration such as audio preferences.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when progress was last updated.

users/{userId}.description: User profile containing game achievements and settings.
